lemmas.title: Concatenation product bound
lemmas.statement: If an outer code has parameters [L,K,D] over F_{2^m} and an injective F_2-linear inner encoding has binary parameters [n_0,m,d_0], then their concatenation has parameters [Ln_0,mK,\geq Dd_0]_2.

lemmas.title: Zero-padding invariance
lemmas.statement: Appending z zero coordinates to a linear [n,k,d]_2 code gives a linear [n+z,k,d]_2 code.

lemmas.title: AG evaluation dimension
lemmas.statement: Let P_1,\ldots,P_L be distinct rational places and let G be disjoint from them with \deg G<L. Then C_L(D,G) has dimension at least \deg G+1-g and minimum distance at least L-\deg G.

directions.title: Optimize the binary inner code
directions.summary: Search symbolically for explicit binary inner codes whose rate-distance tradeoff improves the RM(1,7) concatenation at the fixed final distance.

directions.title: Prove a better tower parameter choice
directions.summary: Vary the exact densified tower level and divisor degree, retaining exact-size padding, to improve the outer dimension without weakening the certified distance.

directions.title: Beyond one-level concatenation
directions.summary: Investigate algebraic concatenation and expander-based distance amplification with parameter identities that remain fully human-auditable at n=2^30.
